name: plugin.evidence_isolation_guard
description: Fail-closed evidence-isolation tripwires (answer keys, grader verdicts) and POSIX-canonical trial identity markers synthesized from google/harness2 (arXiv 2610.14224).

entrypoints.name: assert_no_verdicts
entrypoints.description: Scan an evidence directory tree in bounded chunks with overlap and fail closed if grader verdicts or evaluation markers are found.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: Root path of the evidence directory

entrypoints.name: mark_complete
entrypoints.description: Atomically write a completion marker with harness fingerprint and task input digest.
